name: Conservative review defaults
basis: Illustrative editable starting values, not discovered user preferences or permission to run experiments. Local policy copies should state which preferences were user-stated and which limits remain defaults.

criteria.reason: The person must have a reason to adopt it over the current workflow.
Useful capability or improvement against an explicit baseline.
Repeated opportunities to benefit make setup easier to justify.
Total initial time includes building, learning, integration and testing.
Count maintenance and recurring effort, not just build time.
Relevant observations matter more than an attractive estimate.
Actual attributed outcomes should affect the next evaluation of this same idea.

hard_constraints.reason: Default maximum attention for the proposed first test; editable, not approval.
Default initial-time ceiling for a small personal improvement.

criteria.reason: Assess the communication work created by owning the product.
A route needs evidence; listing a product alone is not a distribution strategy.
A buyer needs a meaningful advantage over current alternatives.
A specific buying situation is more useful than an invented market size.
Count recurring customer help and exceptions.
Count compatibility, corrections and operations.
Use bounded demonstrated contributions or label claimed skills and uncertainty.
An adjacent interest does not prove enthusiasm for running this particular business.
Demand, feasibility and personal fit need separate relevant evidence.
A reported outcome informs this idea, without predicting general market success.

hard_constraints.reason: A desk assessment must fit the default first-test time limit.
Conservative example constraint; confirm or edit the local policy.
A repeatable-product default must not hide client-specific delivery work.
An illustrative cap; acceptable written support must be confirmed locally.

criteria.reason: Protect attention without inventing a financial return.
The possibility of useful thoughts is a hypothesis until the user responds.
An explicit save is a narrow behavioral signal, not a permanent interest.
An attributed revisit may indicate continuing value in context.
Separate invented premises from evidence that they caused useful thought.

hard_constraints.reason: Editable attention budget for one exploration.
Keep the whole proposed exercise within the attention budget.
